description: Waldbrandgefahrenstufen (WBGS) WFS is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geodaten-mv.de. Angabe der tagesaktuellen Gefährdungssituation in 5 Waldbrandgefahrenstufen (internationaler Standard) – 1= sehr niedrig (schwer entzündbar, weiße Rauchfahne, sehr niedrige Ausbreitungsgeschwindigkeit) – 2 = niedrig (niedrige Brandwahrscheinlichkeit, weiß-graue Rauchfahne, niedrige Ausbreitungsgeschwindigkeit) – 3 = mittel (einzelne Flamme kann Brand entfachen, graue Rauchsäule, mäßige Ausbreitungsgeschwindigkeit) – 4 = hoch (einzelne Flamme entfacht Brand, rötlich-schwarze Rauchsäule, hohe Ausbreitungsgeschwindigkeit) ... Coverage: DE. Its keywords include infoFeatureAccessService, Umwelt, infoMapAccessService, Forstwirtschaft, inspireidentifiziert, Gebiete mit naturbedingten Risiken. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WFS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Data licence Germany – attribution – non-commercial – Version 1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
